description: Every TreasurySpring read endpoint, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers portfolio-level questions no single API call can: maturity ladders, obligor concentration, consolidated book, and event diffs.

env_var_specs.name: TS_BEARER_TOKEN
env_var_specs.description: Pre-minted bearer token. OR set TS_CLIENT_ID + TS_CLIENT_SECRET and run `ts auth login`.

env_var_specs.name: TS_CLIENT_ID
env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 client id; used by `ts auth login` to mint a token at /oauth/token.

env_var_specs.name: TS_CLIENT_SECRET
env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 client secret; used by `ts auth login`.

tools.name: event_checkpoint
tools.description: Delete a named event checkpoint. If `expected_checkpoint_version` is supplied, the request uses it as an optimistic lock and returns 409 Conflict if the checkpoint has been modified since you last read it. Required: name. Optional: expected_checkpoint_version. Destructive.

params.name: name
params.description: Name

params.name: expected_checkpoint_version
params.description: Optional checkpointVersion from your last read of this checkpoint. If supplied, it is used as an optimistic lock.

tools.description: Return a single event checkpoint by name. Required: name. Returns the GetCheckpointResponse.

params.name: name
params.description: Name

tools.name: event_checkpoint-checkpoint-2
tools.description: Advance the checkpoint to a new cursor position. Supply the `new_cursor` to move to. If you also provide the `expected_checkpoint_version` from the last read, the request uses it as an optimistic lock and returns 409 Conflict if the checkpoint has changed since you last read it. Required: name, new_cursor. Optional: expected_checkpoint_version.

params.name: name
params.description: Name

params.name: expected_checkpoint_version
params.description: Optional checkpointVersion value from your last read of this checkpoint. If supplied and it no longer matches the current version, the request returns 409 Conflict.

params.name: new_cursor
params.description: New cursor token (ev1.*) to advance the checkpoint to

tools.name: event_checkpoint-checkpoint-3
tools.description: Create a new named event checkpoint, or return the existing one if it already exists. On creation, the cursor is initialised to initial_cursor if provided, or to the current end of the event stream otherwise. initial_cursor is ignored if the checkpoint already exists. Required: name. Returns the updated UpsertCheckpointResponse.

params.name: name
params.description: Name

tools.name: event_checkpoints
tools.description: Return all event checkpoints for the authenticated user, ordered by name. Optional: name_prefix, limit (default: 100). Returns array of CheckpointData.

params.name: name_prefix
params.description: Filter checkpoints whose name starts with this prefix

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of checkpoints to return

tools.name: event_get
tools.description: Return a page of events from the stream. Supports cursor-based pagination with an optional timestamp lower bound. Optional: start_cursor, end_cursor, min_created_at (plus 1 more). Returns array of EventGetItem.

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: Return events after this cursor (exclusive)

params.name: end_cursor
params.description: Return events up to and including this cursor

params.name: min_created_at
params.description: Return events created after this timestamp. ISO 8601 datetime in any timezone. When using a timezone offset, percent-encode the + as %2B (e.g. %2B01:00), or use the Z suffix for UTC.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max events to return
